Computational biology · Bioinformatics

Understanding biology
through data.

I’m a computational biologist (bioinformatician) at Sidra Medicine, specializing in multi-omics integration. I develop algorithms and reproducible workflows to turn complex biological datasets into meaningful discoveries, with over eight years of experience across genomics, epigenomics, and single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.

  • Multi-omics integration
  • Single-cell & spatial
  • Genomics & epigenomics
Explore my research Curriculum vitae

A research journey across

Sidra MedicineSt. Jude Children’s Research HospitalHarvard Medical School

02Research focus

My work connects computational methods with biological questions, from gene regulation and cellular identity to human health. Across these areas, I build analysis workflows and tools that make complex data useful to scientific collaborators.

Connecting the omics

Integrating microbiome, transcriptome, epigenome, metabolome, proteomics, and clinical data to understand complex biological systems.

Multi-omics · Microbiome · Genomics

Decoding cell states

Studying gene regulation, chromatin interactions, and cellular diversity with epigenomics, single-cell analysis, and spatial transcriptomics.

Epigenomics · Single-cell · Spatial

Building tools for discovery

Developing computational methods and reproducible bioinformatics workflows for chromatin interactions, sequencing data, and multi-omics analysis.

Algorithms · Workflows · Research software

04Experience & education

Research appointments

  1. Aug 2023 – Present

    Staff Scientist — Assistant level

    Sidra Medicine
    Perinatal and Reproductive Health Division

    Lead the development, validation, and analysis of transcriptomic, microbiome, epigenomic, and genetics pipelines. Contribute to grants and research publications, and train and supervise junior staff.

  2. Sep 2020 – Jul 2023

    Senior Bioinformatics Research Scientist

    St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital
    Center of Applied Bioinformatics · Epigenetics group

    Developed epigenetics, single-cell, and spatial analysis pipelines, and machine learning methods for pediatric leukemia classification. Collaborated on neuroscience, cancer, and molecular science projects.

  3. Oct 2016 – Sep 2020

    Postdoctoral Research Fellow

    Harvard Medical School
    Yi Zhang lab

    Led and co-led research on preimplantation embryo development and neuroscience. Built pipelines for low-input sequencing, single-cell RNA-seq, and MERFISH spatial transcriptomics, applying statistical and machine learning methods.

  • HiC-3DViewer. A tool for visualizing Hi-C data in three-dimensional space.

Technical expertise
  • Programming: R, Python, C++, Bash, CSS, AWK, LaTeX, JavaScript, HTML.
  • Workflow management: Bpipe, Nextflow, Docker, R targets.
  • Machine learning: Keras, scikit-learn, Caret, tidymodels.
  • Genomics & genetics: WGS, GATK, ONT long-read analysis, GWAS, rare-variant burden analysis, mobile element variant analysis.
  • Transcriptomics: bulk RNA-seq, STAR, Kallisto, RSEM, miRNA profiling, expression-based machine learning classification.
  • Epigenomics: ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN, CUT&TAG, ATAC-seq, WGBS, RRBS, Bismark, EPIC v2 methylation arrays, ChAMP, limma, ComBat.
  • 3D genome: Hi-C, ChIA-PET, FIND, 3CPET, HiC-3DViewer.
  • Single-cell & spatial: scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, multiome, CellRanger, Seurat, scanpy, MERFISH.
  • Microbiome & metagenomics: 16S rRNA, bioBakery, ViroProfiler, phage-host interaction, resistome analysis, microeco, SPIEC-EASI, NetCoMi.
  • Multi-omics integration: cross-omics networks integrating microbiome, transcriptome, methylation, metabolome, proteomics, and clinical data.
  • Core tools: samtools, sambamba, bowtie, pysam, R/Bioconductor, Rsamtools, rtracklayer, GenomicRanges, GenomicFeatures.
  • Cloud: Google Cloud, AWS.
